title: First principles study of two-dimensional Li3CX (X = S and Se) monolayers for hydrogen storage
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,845-857
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01387A, Paper
Sangeeta Meena, Ramandeep Singh, Nidhi Verma, Ashok Kumar
The persistent challenges in designing lightweight, reversible hydrogen storage materials are addressed by utilizing a density functional approach and ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) analysis of newly proposed Li3CX (X = S and Se) monolayers.
